1020.description: Crunch sideways against a band. It works the obliques.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

1084.description: Mountain climbers with feet in straps, which adds instability. It trains the core and conditioning.
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

1148.description: A back-facing plank with the heels in the straps that strengthens the glutes, back and core.
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

1212.description: A standing cable row where you turn your torso as you pull. It works the back with some added core rotation.
instructions: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1276.description: Lying on a decline bench, you open one arm out to the side with a dumbbell and bring it back over your chest. It works the lower chest one side at a time.
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Using your thigh to help raise the dumbbell, lift it up to shoulder width with your palm facing your torso.
Rotate your wrist so that the palm of your hand is facing forward.
As you breathe in, lower the dumbbell slowly to the side until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Exhale and use your chest muscles to bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 躺在斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
用大腿帮助举起哑铃，将其举至与肩同宽，手掌朝向躯干。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
吸气时，将哑铃慢慢降低到一侧，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气并使用胸部肌肉将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1340.description: Lying face down over a stability ball to stretch the lower back.
instructions: Kneel by a stability ball and lay your torso over it.
Roll forward so your hips rest on the ball.
Let your arms and head hang down in a relaxed way.
Breathe slowly and let your lower back release.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

1404.description: A simple stretch to lengthen the back and ease tightness.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and clasp your hands in front of you.
Press your arms forward and round your upper back.
Let your head drop gently.
Breathe slowly into your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

1468.description: From a crab position you twist and reach one hand to the opposite foot. It works the abs and obliques and gets the shoulders moving.
instructions: Start by sitting on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet, and lift your hips off the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you while simultaneously reaching your opposite hand towards your toes.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在身后，手指指向脚部，并将臀部抬离地面。
将一条腿伸直到您面前，同时将另一只手伸向脚趾。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1532.description: A Romanian deadlift standing on a small platform for extra range. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand on a low platform holding the bar at your thighs.
Keep your knees soft and your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower as far as you can with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

1596.description: A smith machine squat down to a bench behind you. The bench gives a consistent depth target.
instructions: Place a bench behind you under the smith bar.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.

1660.description: A dumbbell curl while kneeling on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and demands balance.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with an exercise ball in front of you.
Place your elbows on top of the exercise ball, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地板上，面前放一个健身球。
将肘部放在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1724.description: An overhead triceps extension using a rope on a high pulley. It trains the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and adjust the weight accordingly.
Stand facing away from the pulley machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing down, and bring your hands above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上并相应地调整重量。
背对滑轮机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳子，掌心朝下，双手举过头顶。
保持上臂靠近头部并垂直于地板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1788.description: Straight arms overhead lengthen the chest, shoulders and sides of your back. A simple full-reach stretch.
instructions: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1852.description: A lying leg raise finished with a hip lift that targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

1916.description: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and calves.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1980.description: A classic cross-body stretch for the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2108.description: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2300.description: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a bar at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your body is straight.
Pull your chest up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在腰部高度设置一根横杆，然后躺在其下方。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将胸部向上拉向杠铃。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2364.description: A machine-assisted wide-grip dip with your knees on a pad. Lets you train the chest with less bodyweight.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with a wide grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您想要的高度，并将膝盖固定在垫子上。
宽握手柄并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2748.description: A kneeling machine kickback that extends the hip and works the glutes.
instructions: Kneel on the machine pad and hold the handles.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Press the leg back and up until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

2812.description: A dumbbell step-up combined with a knee drive. Builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Step up onto the bench or step with your right foot, pushing through your heel to lift your body up.
As you step up, simultaneously lift your left knee towards your chest.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your left foot back to the ground while keeping your right foot on the bench or step.
Repeat the movement with your left foot on the bench or step.
Continue alternating between your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在长凳或台阶前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
走到长凳上或用右脚踩上，用脚跟推动身体抬起。
当你向上迈步时，同时将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢将左脚放回地面，同时将右脚放在长凳或台阶上。
将左脚放在长凳或台阶上，重复该动作。
继续交替左右脚，达到所需的重复次数。

2876.description: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

2940.description: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.
instructions: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

3004.description: A fast-paced walk that lifts your heart rate without the impact of running. Easy on the joints and good for steady fitness.
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

3068.description: A standing cable curl with a rope for constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.

3132.description: A deep squat done holding a support for balance. Works the glutes and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3196.description: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3260.description: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

3324.description: An alternating band press angled upward, with a torso twist added to bring in your core. It works the upper chest and trunk together.
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.

3388.description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

3452.description: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

3516.description: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3580.description: A push-up with hands on kettlebell handles to lower the chest deeper than the floor allows.
instructions: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

3644.description: A weighted lunge with an arm swing as you step forward. It trains the glutes, quads and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, keeping your arms straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position, swinging the weights back down.
Repeat with your left foot and continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个重物。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前冲时，向前和向上摆动重物，保持手臂伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置，将重物向下摆动。
用左脚重复上述动作，并继续交替双腿，完成所需的重复次数。

3708.description: Lunges done at a brisk pace to lift your heart rate while working the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

3772.description: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3836.description: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to about 135 degrees. It builds grip and pulling strength in a partly pulled position.
instructions: Grip the hold and pull up slightly so your elbows bend to about 135 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

3964.description: A push up with a rotation at the top. It trains the chest and arms and adds core work.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and rotate one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Alternate sides each rep.

4028.description: A warm-up from a low squat position, moving a band in front of you to loosen the shoulders and hips together.
instructions: Hold the band in front of you and sink into a comfortable deep squat.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band at shoulder height.
Bring your hands back together under control.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps, then stand up.

4092.description: A seated overhead extension with added weight that isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench and hold the weight overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Keep your back straight and core tight.

4156.description: A side lying raise where you lift both legs together toward the ceiling. It works the obliques and the sides of your trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight.
Rest your head on your lower arm and brace your core.
Lift both legs together a short way off the floor.
Pause at the top, squeezing your side.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

4220.description: Rolling a handheld foam roller along your forearm to ease tight muscles. It is a quick self-massage for grip and wrists.
instructions: Rest your forearm on a table, palm up.
Hold the tiger tail roller in your other hand.
Roll slowly from wrist to elbow with moderate pressure.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Turn your palm down and repeat.
Switch arms and roll for 30-60 seconds each.

4348.description: A four-point hold on hands and knees where you engage the abs. A gentle way to learn core bracing.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Draw your belly button toward your spine.
Hold for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally.
Relax and repeat.

4412.description: A band pull-apart with an overhand grip and arms at 90 degrees that hits the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand holding a band in front of you at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

4476.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the psoas area beside the belly button. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your psoas area beside the belly button while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4540.description: A squat into an overhead press with a single dumbbell, training the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4604.description: A hip hinge drill with a light pipe on your back, teaching you to bend at the hips with a flat spine.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.

4732.description: A deep side-to-side squat holding a dumbbell at the chest. It works the thighs and glutes and opens up the hips.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down on that leg.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Drive through the bent leg to stand and shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and your heel down.

4796.description: A one-leg calf raise that also challenges balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand tall on one foot with the other lifted.
Keep your hands on your hips or lightly on a wall.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4860.description: A push-up followed by a knee drive toward the chest. It combines upper-body strength with core work.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return and alternate legs.

4924.description: A prone back extension with the arms stretched long overhead. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Squeeze your glutes to stabilize.
Lift your chest and arms off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral by looking down.

4988.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where you lower your torso against the pads. It is very demanding for the back of the thighs.
instructions: Anchor your ankles under the bench pads and kneel upright.
Cross your arms or hold them in front of you.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

5052.description: One-legged calf raise from the edge of a step. It builds calf strength with a deep stretch.
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail for balance.
Let your heel lower below the step.
Rise as high as possible on your toes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

5308.description: A sit-up that adds a twist while holding an EZ bar. Works the abs and obliques together.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold the EZ bar over your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up position.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side, moving the bar with you.
Rotate back to center and lower yourself with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep the weight light enough to move smoothly.

5372.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the neck. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently nod your chin and let your head relax into the roller.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5628.description: Squat with a landmine bar held at your chest, mimicking a hack squat.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep the bar close.

5820.description: Lying face down, raise light dumbbells out in a Y with thumbs up. It strengthens the rear shoulder and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly under control.

5884.description: Curl, press and overhead extension chained into one rep with dumbbells, giving the biceps, shoulders and triceps a full workout.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.

6076.description: An overhead press with a bottle in each hand. It builds shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Do not arch your lower back.

6140.description: A seated rotator cuff exercise using a light dumbbell. It strengthens the small muscles that stabilize the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6268.description: A one-arm wrist curl with a neutral grip on an EZ barbell. It targets the forearms.
instructions: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.
Keep your arm at your side.
Curl your wrist up.
Squeeze the forearm.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

7228.description: A pull-up on rings with a wide grip. The unstable rings make the lats and stabilizers work harder.
instructions: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

7548.description: Kettlebell swing flowing into a goblet squat for hips, legs and grip.
instructions: Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.

8188.description: A standing mobility drill that rotates the ankle through its full range. It warms up the ankle joints.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.

8892.description: A deadlift with a staggered stance holding a kettlebell. It loads one leg more than the other.
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch stances after your set.

8956.description: Sliding down a wall into a squat with your heels planted teaches good squat depth and control. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

9980.description: A shoulder mobility drill where a stick helps one arm lift forward and overhead. The other hand guides the movement.
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

10044.description: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

10108.description: An explosive throw of a medicine ball from behind the head forward. It builds power from hips to arms.
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.

10556.description: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

10748.description: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.

11260.description: A kneeling overhead press with cables. The position keeps your legs out of it, so the shoulders do the work.
instructions: Kneel between two low pulleys and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press both handles straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

11452.description: A standing calf stretch variation that lengthens the lower leg muscles and helps ankle mobility.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

11644.description: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg against band resistance to work the outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0060.description: The classic skull crusher: lower the bar to the forehead and extend the arms. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your forehead, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额。
当杠铃位于前额上方时暂停片刻，然后将手臂向后伸展至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0124.description: A back squat with a wide stance. Works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你下蹲时，收紧你的核心并保持胸部挺直，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0188.description: A standing cable fly at chest height. You bring the handles together in front of you to squeeze the chest.
instructions: Attach cables to both sides of a cable machine at chest height.
Stand in the center of the machine with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms out to the sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and maintain a slight forward lean.
Engage your chest muscles and bring your arms forward in a sweeping motion.
Pause for a moment at the center, then slowly return your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到电缆机两侧胸部高度处。
站在机器的中央，一只脚稍微在另一只脚前面。
正手握住手柄，并将手臂向两侧伸展。
保持肘部轻微弯曲并保持轻微前倾。
收紧胸部肌肉，并以扫过的动作将手臂向前伸。
在中心停顿片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0316.description: An incline dumbbell move that lowers the weights to the chest sides and presses up. It targets the upper chest.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing forward.
Start with your arms fully extended, perpendicular to the ground.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝前。
首先，双臂完全伸展，垂直于地面。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部两侧，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0380.description: Bent over at the hips, you raise dumbbells out to the sides. It trains the rear shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0508.description: A sit-up with the glutes and quads squeezed to take the hip flexors out of play. It focuses on the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0572.description: A machine that helps lift your body weight so you can train chin-ups at a lower load. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to your desired resistance level.
Stand on the foot platform and grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the handles, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the handles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机调整至您想要的阻力水平。
站在脚踏板上，正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，保持身体挺直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向手柄，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于手柄上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0636.description: Standing with an Olympic barbell, you curl with a neutral style grip. Works the biceps and brachialis along with the forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold an Olympic barbell with an overhand grip.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palms facing your body.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，正手握住奥林匹克杠铃。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，手掌与身体保持一臂距离。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0700.description: Lying sideways over a stability ball, you bend toward the ceiling. It targets the side of the waist.
instructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball with feet braced.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body over the ball.
Lift back up by contracting the obliques.
Keep your hips steady.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0764.description: A press with an underhand grip on the smith bar, lowering to the chest and pressing back up. It trains the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back and position yourself with a slight bend in your knees.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Lower the bar towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整至胸部水平。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
退后一步，膝盖稍微弯曲。
在整个练习过程中保持挺胸并保持核心参与。
将杠铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部内收。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0828.description: Easy walking on a machine or track at a steady pace, great for warming up or building a base of aerobic fitness.
instructions: Step onto the machine and set a comfortable speed.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Swing your arms naturally as you walk.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Walk for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still talk.
Slow down gradually at the end.

0892.description: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the muscles between your shoulder blades and the lats.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in your hands.
Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

0956.description: Sit cross-legged with each foot resting on the opposite thigh. It opens the hips and encourages a calm, upright posture.
instructions: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.
